# Commit authorship allowlist
#
# Every commit's author AND committer email must appear here, and every
# Co-authored-by trailer must reference one of these addresses. Each entry is a
# verified email of a real person's GitHub account, so that a human is always
# accountable for the change -- including changes produced with an LLM or coding
# agent. The agent commits AS the human; it never commits under a bot identity
# and never credits itself as author or co-author.
#
# Add a contributor by appending an email that is verified on their GitHub
# account. The privacy-preserving "name@users.noreply.github.com" address that
# GitHub provides is a good choice. One email per line; "#" starts a comment.
